item.tib: mnyam med brgya pa'i mgon po rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi rnam bshad khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi 'od
item.coloph: ces rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi rnam par bshad pa khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi 'od ces bya ba 'di ni/ khrims gnyis kyi rnga sgra'i gnam sa bar med du khengs pa'i rab brtan mi yi dbang po mu la wer ro khu tsha zung gi thugs bzhed du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i zhal skyin gyi ri mor 'os pa dang / bu mo 'od 'bar khro chung gi nang so mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug drung mu mu la wang pa nas kyang 'di lta bu zhig mdzad na legs tshul gyi bka' phebs pa dang / phran rgan kun grol grags pa rang gis yab rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i mdzes rgyan du 'gro ba'i lhag bsam dkar po dang bcas 'dzin byed ces pa me pho shing bya'i lo yi ? ba'i tshes la rab brtan rgyal khab tu bgyis pa bstan pa'i rgyan dang sems can gyi don brgya (rgya) chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/
